bias.zh: 反弹 · 收复 100 日和 200 日均线，测试 $643–648

read.en: Meta rose 2.9% on Nov 13 to $641.69, trading $624.83–643.91 on light volume (0.63x the 20-day average). It is above the rising 5-day ($635.4) and 10-day ($625.0), the rising 100-day ($636.9) and the 200-day ($630.8), and below the 30-day ($669.1). MACD has been above its signal since Nov 11, below zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Nov 9 ($594.65), and RSI is 47.8.
read.zh: Meta 11月13日上涨 2.9%，收于 $641.69，盘中区间 $624.83–643.91，成交量偏低（20 日均量的 0.63 倍）。股价位于上行的 5 日（$635.4）和 10 日均线（$625.0）、上行的 100 日均线（$636.9）及 200 日均线（$630.8）上方，位于 30 日均线（$669.1）下方。MACD 自 11月11日起位于信号线上方，在零轴下方，柱状图扩大；抛物线 SAR 自 11月9日起看多（$594.65），RSI 为 47.8。

read.en: The close reclaimed the 200 and 100-day and the $629–636 band, now support, and finished just under the $643.1–648.5 cap. Resistance is $643.1–648.5 (Nov 4–11 highs), then $669 (30-day) and $681 (Oct 22 high). Support is $630.8–636.9 (200, 5 and 100-day), then $618.9–625 (10-day, Nov 12–13 lows) and $594.7 (SAR). A close above $648.5 would target $669; below $630.8, $619–625.
